subject: Partner co-sell demo — ops rotation & timebox coordination
thread_body:
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Moore <ethan.moore@talos.io>, Priyanka Shaw <priyanka@amazon.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Partner co-sell demo — ops rotation & timebox coordination

Hi Ethan / Priyanka —

Thanks again for lining up the Talos SI and AWS SI coverage for the marketplace demo next week. We want to lock the technical walkthrough + live Q&A and also confirm run-of-show handoffs (who mutes/unmutes, who owns recordings, fallback host).

Proposed windows (PST):
- Option A: Tue 11/10 09:00–10:00 PT (preferred for Redwood ops)
- Option B: Tue 11/10 14:00–15:00 PT (works better for EMEA attendees)

We'd like to do a 30-min dry run the day before with tech leads (to test SSO, data routing to the demo tenant, and the recording flow). Attached is a short runbook (redwood-runbook-v1.pdf) and an .ics with the above times.

Please confirm which option works and whether Talos needs a specific dry-run time. Also confirm the SI engineer who will own the run-of-show handoff.

Thanks,
Olga
Sr. Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-runbook-v1.pdf (runbook, 3 pages)
Attachment: calendar-proposed-times.ics

From: Ethan Moore <ethan.moore@talos.io>

Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan@nebula-systems.com>, Priyanka Shaw <priyanka@amazon.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 13:48:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Partner co-sell demo — ops rotation & timebox coordination

Thanks Olga — quick heads up: our SI lead (Jordan) is traveling on Tue afternoon and asked if we can avoid late-day slots. Option A is doable for Talos, but Jordan asked if we can move the dry run to Mon 11/9 16:00 PT instead of Mon morning. He also flagged that his network at the hotel is flaky, so he plans to dial in from his phone as a last resort for the dry run — we should keep the dry run short and focus on auth and recording handoff.

Proposed adjusted schedule (Talos constraints):
- Demo: Tue 11/10 09:00–10:00 PT (Option A confirmed)
- Dry run: Mon 11/9 16:00–16:30 PT

I can host the Talos side of the dry run and share a brief setup checklist. Please loop in whoever owns the recording on your side (I see Vivek on cc).

—Ethan
Ethan Moore
Sales Engineer, Talos Systems
ethan.moore@talos.io

Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 07:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partner co-sell demo — ops rotation & timebox coordination

All — thanks for the options. AWS SI is good with Option A (Tue 09:00 PT). A couple of asks from our side:

- Can you call out region constraints? We'll need to confirm the demo tenant is running us-west-2 resources; otherwise we may need to caveat performance numbers in the demo.
- Please include a short attendee list for the recording permission (we need to approve any external recording for AWS attendees).

Happy to join the dry run on Mon 11/9 16:00 PT. If Talos prefers an earlier dry run for timezone reasons, we can be flexible but prefer the 16:00 slot.

Thanks,
Priyanka Shaw
Partner Solutions, AWS Marketplace
priyanka@amazon.com

Thanks team — confirming updated plan below and next steps:

Confirmed schedule (PST):
- Dry run: Mon 11/9 16:00–16:30 PT (team leads only)
- Demo: Tue 11/10 09:00–10:00 PT (public-facing)

Vanessa notes / ops items:
- Recording owner on Redwood side: Vivek (will make recording available in shared Drive and upload highlight clip).
- Backup host: Vanessa (can take over if Vivek gets disconnected).
- Please confirm attendee list below by EOD Mon 11/9 so AWS compliance can sign off on recording permissions.

- Redwood: Olga Petrov (olga@redwood.com), Vivek Kulkarni (vivek@redwood.com), Vanessa Ortiz (vanessa@redwood.com), Karthik Iyer (karthik@redwood.com)
